title: free-disk-space source component diagram
description: The modules of the one free-disk-space binary and what each reaches outside the process. The scan records directories, file names and compression candidates in a SQLite state file; compress and dedupe act only on what it recorded; clean and the daemon work without it. All modules are compiled into one process; none is deployed on its own.

components.name: free-disk-space source
components.responsibility: The binary's code: one module per command family plus shared helpers.

components.name: Command line (main.rs)
components.responsibility: Parses the subcommands and flags with clap, fills in defaults such as the state path, and dispatches to the command modules.

components.name: Scan (scan.rs)
components.responsibility: Walks a root directory, recording every directory, every file's path, leaf name and size, and the compression candidates, in the state file; resumable after Ctrl-C; also status and list.

components.name: Compression (compress.rs)
components.responsibility: Compresses pending candidates in place: a verified ditto --hfsCompression copy into a temp file beside the original, swapped in by rename; first checks with a probe file that ditto really compresses, and tallies skips by reason.

components.name: Clone dedupe (dedupe.rs)
components.responsibility: Hashes same-named, same-sized files the scan recorded and replaces identical ones with verified copy-on-write clones of one kept copy.

components.name: Cleanup (clean.rs)
components.responsibility: Deletes regenerable files per target: caches, Xcode derived data, Downloads, Trash, dev build artifacts, Homebrew's cache and Docker's images and build cache, with a running total; records the steps an applying run finishes so an interrupted run resumes after them; also the process snapshot dedupe reuses.

components.name: Daemon (daemon.rs)
components.responsibility: Checks free space on an awake-time cadence and runs clean when it is below a threshold; installs, removes and reports itself as a launchd login item.

components.name: Helpers (util.rs)
components.responsibility: Output and colour, sizes, progress lines, the Ctrl-C stop flag, subprocesses with time limits, free space, awake time, display state, BSD file flags, hashes and xattr names.

components.name: Scan state file
components.responsibility: A SQLite database (bundled by rusqlite) at $FDS_STATE or ~/.local/state/free-disk-space/scan.sqlite3, holding the scan's settings, progress, directories, file names and candidates.

components.name: Clean progress file
components.responsibility: A text file at ~/.local/state/free-disk-space/clean-progress.txt, one finished step per line (dir:, dev: or target: and its name), kept only while an applying clean is interrupted and for at most 12 hours.

components.name: APFS clone and metadata calls
components.responsibility: macOS clonefile and copyfile, called directly to clone a file copy-on-write and copy its ACL, mode, owner, flags, times and xattrs.

components.name: macOS file tools
components.responsibility: /usr/bin/ditto (compressed copy, and a probe copy in the temp directory) and /usr/bin/xattr (extended attribute names and removal).

components.name: Process listing tools
components.responsibility: lsof (open files and working directories) and ps (command lines) of running processes.

components.name: git
components.responsibility: Tells whether a build artifact directory is inside a work tree, ignored and untracked.

components.name: Finder
components.responsibility: Empties the Trash when asked through osascript.

components.name: Docker Desktop
components.responsibility: Prunes images and build cache, stops containers and quits, through the docker CLI and osascript.

components.name: Homebrew
components.responsibility: Removes its old downloads and versions (brew cleanup --prune=all -s).

components.name: launchd
components.responsibility: Starts the daemon at login and keeps it running, from the plist the install writes; driven with /bin/launchctl.

relationships.description: The entry point.
Scan, status and list.
Verified compression.
Clone dedupe.
Cleanup targets.
Background mode.
Shared helpers used by every module.
new, resume, status and list call cmd_new, cmd_resume, cmd_status and cmd_list.
compress calls cmd_compress with CompressOpts.
dedupe calls cmd_dedupe with DedupeOpts.
clean calls cmd_clean with the target names.
daemon run, install, uninstall and status; options are validated into daemon::Settings first.
Opens the state with open_db and warns when the scan has not finished.
Opens the state with open_db, and reuses under and SKIP_PREFIXES to recognise system files.
Reuses clean::Snapshot to skip files a running process has open.
Runs clean::cmd_clean with --apply on its targets when free space is below the threshold.
Creates the schema and writes directories, files, candidates and progress, committing about every 2 seconds.
Reads pending candidates and writes each one's status, note and verified saving.
Reads name groups from the files table and marks replaced files cloned.
Progress::load reads it for an applying run, mark appends each finished step, finish removes it after a complete run.
ditto --hfsCompression of a probe file before the run, then into each temp file; xattr to compare attribute names.
lsof -t on each file before compressing it.
clonefile into the temp file, copyfile to give it the target's metadata (macOS only; a plain copy elsewhere).
xattr to compare attribute names and remove ones the target lacks.
Snapshot::capture runs lsof and ps once per run.
rev-parse, check-ignore and ls-files on each artifact's parent, with optional locks off.
The trash target, with --apply on macOS.
The docker target, only if Docker Desktop is already running.
The brew target, if brew is on PATH.
install writes the plist and runs launchctl bootout then bootstrap; uninstall runs bootout; status runs print.
